kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننتقد (form VIII)
# نَنْتَقِدُ (nantaqidu) /nan.ta.qi.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
# نُنْتَقَدُ (nuntaqadu) /nun.ta.qa.du/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
# نَنْتَقِدَ (nantaqida) /nan.ta.qi.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
# نُنْتَقَدَ (nuntaqada) /nun.ta.qa.da/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
